children: Curran Terrie, a non-employee director, reported sales of Arcutis Biotherapeutics common stock on August 27, 2026. The filing notes a weighted average selling price of $25.0294 per share, with sales executed in multiple trades at prices ranging from $25.00 to $25.1001. The total reported sale amount was $956,123 for 38,200 shares sold. Following the transactions, Curran Terrie directly owns 23,526 shares of common stock. The filing includes footnotes describing the vesting terms of underlying options and the availability of detailed price breakdowns upon request.
